note: Single source of truth for the Paperclip trading desk. $BUSINESS_ROOT is expanded to an absolute path by bootstrap.sh before anything reaches the server. The authoritative risk limits live in docs/trading/risk-policy.md — this file only points at them.

company.name: Digitraders
company.description: Digitraders — a home trading center where AI agents research, build and operate a Kraken spot trading desk under hard risk limits.

trading.note: Agents MUST read the mode file before proposing execution. Default is paper; live mode is set by the human only.

goals.title: Trade safely
goals.description: Every live trade clears the written risk policy and an explicit human approval. No exceptions, no overrides.

goals.title: Prove the strategy before risking capital
goals.description: A strategy earns live capital only after it survives backtest, walk-forward, and paper trading.

goals.title: Run the desk every day
goals.description: Agents research, analyse, build and report on a rhythm; the human approves and decides.

projects.name: Trading Engine
projects.description: Strategies, backtesting, and the execution plumbing. Everything that could place an order.

projects.name: Market Research
projects.description: Market data, signals, regime notes and competitor research. Read-heavy, no execution.

projects.name: Risk and Operations
projects.description: Risk policy, P&L, trade journal, secrets hygiene, and the daily dashboard.

workspaces.name: engine
workspaces.purpose: Strategy code, backtests, and the execution client. The only workspace allowed to talk to an exchange.

workspaces.name: research
workspaces.purpose: Market data, signals, notes, and research. No keys, no orders.

workspaces.name: ops
workspaces.purpose: Risk policy, P&L reports, trade journal, dashboards.
